title: letcode configuration
description: Configuration for ~/.config/letcode/letcode.toml. Unknown keys are rejected at every level.

active_provider.description: Provider used by the current session. Must name a key under [providers]; defaults to the first one.

fast_mode.description: Trade retries and reasoning waits for speed. Also toggled inside a session with /fast.

mcp.description: Model Context Protocol servers, one table per server name.

providers.description: Model providers, one table per provider name.

global.description: Session-wide limits, paths, input handling, retry policy, and transcript archiving.

max_iterations.description: Maximum iterations within one interactive turn. Unbounded when omitted.

max_tool_calls.description: Maximum tool calls within one interactive turn. Unbounded when omitted.

tool_timeout_secs.description: Default timeout for ordinary tools in seconds. shell__exec keeps its own 120 second default.

sessions_dir.description: Session transcript directory, resolved relative to the configuration directory.

log_file.description: Runtime log file, resolved relative to the configuration directory.

submit_while_running.description: How new input received during an active turn is handled. `insert` closes the turn at the next tool batch boundary or at turn end and runs the input next; `queue` waits for the active turn to finish.

preserve_recent_tokens.description: Tokens retained at the end of history during compaction. Derived from the model input budget when omitted.

session_archive.description: Background archiving for idle session transcripts.

enabled.description: Archive idle session transcripts in the background.

older_than_days.description: Idle days after which a transcript is archived. Archived sessions still resume.

retry.description: Physical retry policy. A provider level table inherits fields it does not declare from here.

enabled.description: Retry failed requests. When false, the first failure is returned.

max_attempts.description: Attempts allowed before a request produces output, counting the first.

max_recovery_attempts.description: Recovery attempts allowed after a request produced partial output.

initial_delay_secs.description: Delay before the first retry; the fixed delay when exponential_backoff = false.

exponential_backoff.description: Grow the delay by backoff_multiplier after each retry. When false, every retry waits initial_delay_secs.

backoff_multiplier.description: Growth factor applied to the delay after each retry when exponential_backoff is true.

jitter_secs.description: Maximum random extra delay added to each retry.

permissions.description: Tool approval policy for the session.

mode.description: safe asks before every tool; default allows reads and asks for writes; auto answers approvals with the reviewer expert; yolo allows everything. solo is an alias of yolo.

parallelism.description: Per-tool concurrency. It can only lower a tool that already allows parallel calls.

additionalProperties.description: Concurrency for this tool: parallel or exclusive.

mcpServer.description: One MCP server. local runs a stdio command; remote connects to a URL.

type.description: local runs command over stdio; remote connects to url over HTTP.

enabled.description: Also toggled inside a session with /mcp; the choice is written back here.

timeout.description: Response and method-call timeout in milliseconds.

items.description: One argv element; the first element is the executable.

command.description: Executable and arguments of a local stdio server. Required for type = "local".

additionalProperties.description: Value of this environment variable for a local server.

environment.description: Environment variables passed to a local server. Aliased as `env`.

additionalProperties.description: Value of this environment variable for a local server.

url.description: Endpoint of a remote server. Required for type = "remote".

additionalProperties.description: Value of this request header for a remote server.

headers.description: Extra request headers for a remote server.

oauth.description: Remote MCP OAuth is not supported; leave it false and authenticate through headers.

subagents.description: Subagent execution mode and limits for the session tree.

mode.description: expert lets the parent delegate to a named expert; swarm allows bounded recursive delegation in the session tree.

max_depth.description: Inclusive descendant depth limit. The root has depth 0.

max_concurrent.description: Maximum concurrent subagents in the session tree, including starting and message wakeup reservations. Mutually exclusive with max_descendants.

max_descendants.description: Deprecated alias for max_concurrent. Mutually exclusive with max_concurrent.

max_pending_messages.description: Pending message queue capacity per session.

max_message_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 body size of one message in bytes.

run_timeout_secs.description: Default timeout for a swarm run in seconds when not specified by the request or template. Must fit the platform deadline range.

agents.description: Per-expert routing. The expert names are fixed.

agentRoute.description: Route for this expert. allowed_models lists the routes it may use; provider and model pin one default.

provider.description: Provider key from [providers]. Must be set together with model.

model.description: Model key under the provider's [models]. Must be set together with provider.

allowed_models.description: Routes this expert may use, written as provider/model. The first one is its default and also bounds model overrides in a single delegation.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning level for every run of this expert. The model it resolves to must support it.

backend.description: Approval-review transport for the reviewer expert. chat uses the normal model route; jev posts to the provider's Jev endpoint.

provider.description: One model provider. auth and endpoints are required.

default_model.description: Model used when a route does not name one. Must be a key under this provider's [models].

reviewer.description: Legacy Jev marker. Set agents.reviewer.backend instead; the loader still reads this field.

headers.description: Extra request headers. Reserved and duplicate headers are rejected.

query.description: Extra query parameters. Reserved and duplicate keys are rejected.

models.description: Model routes under this provider, keyed by model id.

protocol.description: Wire protocol. Adapter defaults apply when omitted.

flavor.description: Explicit provider profile. Never inferred from the provider or model name.

type.description: bearer sends Authorization: Bearer; header and query require `name`; none takes no credential.

name.description: Header or query parameter carrying the credential. Required by the header and query schemes.

credential.description: Literal credential. The environment variable named by credential_env takes precedence.

credential_env.description: Environment variable holding the credential. Defaults to <PROVIDER>_API_KEY.

endpoints.description: Base URL and optional path or query overrides per protocol.

base_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL without query parameters or fragments.

endpointOverride.description: Path or query override for one protocol endpoint.

path.description: Protocol path overriding the adapter default. May be absolute.

query.description: Query parameters appended to the endpoint.

providerTransport.description: HTTP transport settings for this provider.

no_proxy_loopback.description: Bypass the proxy for loopback addresses.

model.description: One model route. Capabilities gate the generation defaults.

effective_input_limit_tokens.description: Optional cap on the input budget. The budget derived from context_window is used when omitted.

model_override.description: Wire model id sent upstream when it differs from the configuration key.

websocket.description: Use WebSocket transport for Responses agent turns when the endpoint supports it. One-shot requests stay on HTTP/SSE.

protocol_settings.description: Adapter-owned settings. Anthropic reads anthropic_thinking = { mode, budget_tokens } and anthropic_betas, and needs protocol = "anthropic".

strategy.description: Model request strategy. Inferred from the model name when omitted.

capabilities.description: Declared model capabilities. Every flag defaults to false.

tools.description: Allow tool definitions and tool calls.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Allow multiple tool calls in one assistant turn.

reasoning.description: Allow reasoning output; required for reasoning_effort settings.

priority_service.description: Use the provider's priority service tier.

structured_output.description: JSON output contract. json_schema constrains JSON syntax in the decoder; json_object only states the intent.

generation.description: Per-turn generation defaults. Protocol and model capabilities determine which parameters are accepted.

async_tools.description: Tool names dispatched asynchronously. Requires the Astra strategy, protocol = "responses" and capabilities.tools = true.

reasoning_effort.description: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or a provider specific value.

reasoning_efforts.description: Reasoning levels the session may switch between for this model.

reasoning_summary.description: Reasoning summary style. Requires responses protocol and reasoning capability.

text_verbosity.description: Output verbosity. Requires responses or completions protocol.

enabled.description: Sole switch for provider-native prompt caching on this route.

retention.description: Cache retention. 24h is Responses only and requires enabled = true.

namespace.description: Prompt cache namespace. Defaults to the protocol name (completions or responses).

fake.description: Request values used while the session level /fake switch is on. Every field is optional; absent values are derived from the real host or from the imitated client.

identity.description: Identity values reported while /fake is on. Missing values are generated per installation.

installation_id.description: UUID reported as the client installation id; generated and persisted when omitted.

agent_name.description: Agent name in Codex turn metadata. Omitted when unset.

account_uuid.description: Account id reported by the Claude profile. Derived when omitted.

clock.description: Clock values reported while /fake is on.

timezone.description: IANA zone name, for example Asia/Shanghai.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD override. Derived from the real clock in the declared zone when omitted.

fakeCodex.description: Codex client profile reported while /fake codex is on. Unset fields use host values or the imitated client's defaults.

version.description: Client version in the user agent.

originator.description: Originator name in headers and turn metadata.

os.description: OS name reported to the provider. Host OS when omitted.

arch.description: CPU architecture reported to the provider. Host architecture when omitted.

terminal.description: Terminal name in the user agent. Detected terminal when omitted.

beta_features.description: Beta feature names sent in x-codex-beta-features.

sandbox.description: Sandbox name in the environment context.

sandbox_mode.description: Sandbox mode in the environment context.

auto_review_enabled.description: Report auto review as enabled in turn metadata.

node_repl_auto_review_required.description: Report node REPL auto review as required in turn metadata.

node_repl_disabled.description: Report the node REPL as disabled in turn metadata.

cwd.description: Working directory in the environment context. Current directory when omitted.

workspace.description: Workspace path in the environment context. Defaults to cwd.

shell.description: Shell name in the environment context. Detected shell when omitted.

git_commit_hash.description: Git commit hash in the environment context. Read from the working tree when omitted.

git_remote_url.description: Git remote URL in the environment context. Read from the working tree when omitted.

git_has_changes.description: Whether the working tree has changes. Read from the working tree when omitted.

extra.description: Extra turn metadata keys, at most 16, each up to 64 bytes and starting with an ASCII letter; values up to 128 bytes. Keys the turn already sets are rejected.

fakeClaude.description: Claude Code profile reported while /fake claude is on. Unset fields use the imitated client's published values.

version.description: Client version in the user agent and billing header.

build.description: Build id in the billing header.

os.description: Value of x-stainless-os. Host OS when omitted.

arch.description: Value of x-stainless-arch. Host architecture when omitted.

betas.description: Values of anthropic-beta. Defaults depend on the permission mode.
